description: Document verification tools (doc_*) and fact_validate: results every SDK must share. Expected values are written by hand from the rules in docs/document-verification.md; document IDs, fact IDs and spans follow their published definitions (SHA-256 of the pages joined by form feeds; flf_ + Crockford base32 of SHA-256(subject, predicate, document_id, quote joined by U+001F); code-point offsets in that joined text). In arguments, {"$pages": name} stands for documents[name]. An expected value of null means the path is absent. canonical_json pins RFC 8785 serialization for fact packages. A case with "requires": "signing" needs Ed25519 (the cryptography package in Python) and is skipped without it.

OFFICE LEASE (SYNTHETIC TEST DOCUMENT - NOT A REAL LEASE)

This Office Lease is entered into by Sample Landlord LLC (“Landlord”) and Example Tenant, Inc. (“Tenant”).

1.1 Premises. Suite 400, containing approximately 12,500 rentable square feet.
1.2 Term. The Term shall commence on March 1, 2026 (the “Commencement Date”) and shall expire on
June 30, 2031, unless sooner terminated.

2.1 Base Rent. Base Rent for the period from March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027 shall be $38.00 per rentable square foot per annum, and for the period from March 1, 2027 through June 30, 2031 shall be $39.14 per rentable square foot per annum.
2.2 Tenant’s Pro-
portionate Share is 4.25%.
2.3 Controllable Operating Expenses shall not increase by more than five percent (5%) per year on a cumulative, compounding basis.

3.1 Security Deposit. Upon execution Tenant shall deposit with Landlord the sum of $1,250,000.00 as security.
3.2 Renewal. Tenant shall have one (1) option to extend the Term for sixty (60) months by notice given not less than twelve (12) months before expiration.
3.3 Notices. Notices are effective five (5) days after mailing.
3.4 Parking. Tenant may use forty (40) parking spaces for the 12,500 rentable square feet.

retail_lease:
RETAIL LEASE (SYNTHETIC TEST DOCUMENT - NOT A REAL LEASE)

Section 6.1 Exclusive Use. Landlord shall not lease space in the Shopping Center to another tenant for the sale of coffee, espresso and espresso-based beverages, except (a) a full-service restaurant may sell coffee with meals, and (b) any tenant may make incidental sales of bottled coffee drinks in up to 10% of its floor area.
Section 6.2 Prohibited Uses. No part of the Shopping Center shall be used for a bar or tavern, a massage parlor, a pawn shop, or a bowling alley.
Section 6.3 Co-Tenancy. If fewer than 70% of the gross leasable area of the Shopping Center is open for business, or if Anchor Grocer, Inc. ceases to operate, Tenant may pay 50% of Base Rent in lieu of Base Rent, and if the failure continues for twelve (12) months, Tenant may terminate this Lease.

Section 7.1 Operation. Tenant shall continuously operate in the Premises. If Tenant ceases operating for more than 180 consecutive days, Landlord may recapture the Premises.
Section 7.2 Radius. During the Term, Tenant shall not operate another coffee shop within 3 miles of the Shopping Center.
Section 7.3 Relocation. Landlord may relocate Tenant to substantially similar premises on 90 days' notice, at Landlord's cost.
Section 7.4 Kick-Out. If Gross Sales in the third Lease Year are less than $600,000, Tenant may terminate this Lease on 120 days' notice.
Section 8.1 Assignment. Tenant shall not assign this Lease without Landlord's consent, which shall not be unreasonably withheld, conditioned or delayed; Landlord shall receive 50% of any transfer profit.
Section 8.2 Right of First Refusal. Tenant shall have a right of first refusal on the adjacent Suite 105, exercisable within 10 business days of Landlord's notice.
